questions.question: Where is the vertex of an inscribed angle?
choices: Outside the circle in every case
At the midpoint of a radius

questions.question: What forms the sides of an inscribed angle?
choices: Two radii with a central vertex
Two diameters that do not meet

questions.question: How does an inscribed angle relate to its intercepted arc?
choices: Its measure is half the arc measure
Its measure equals the arc measure

Its measure is 180° minus the arc measure

choices: An arc whose measure is less than 180°
